profile_text.body:
Appian Corp is a public company headquartered in McLean, Virginia, traded under the ticker APPN. According to its website, Appian sells an enterprise platform for AI-powered process orchestration, which it describes as orchestrating AI agents, systems, and people without replacing existing systems. The site says the company has been automating processes for more than 25 years and that customers use the Appian Platform to build AI-powered processes. It also describes itself as a Leader in Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies (BOAT), citing a Gartner assessment of 20 BOAT vendors, and references an AI Value Study with Harvard Business Review Analytic Services.

The site lists uses across finance and accounting, sourcing and procurement, case management, compliance and audit, and onboarding, and says onboarding time can be cut by up to 50%. It describes low-code app building with embedded AI agents that can extract data, act autonomously, and generate code from natural language prompts, along with process automation, legacy application modernization, and agentic orchestration models.

The company's record shows no tracked AI products, no MCP servers, and no lawsuits. Its registered address of record is in Virginia, where 152 cases are recorded.
